Kill [[the Greater Darkness]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the Greater Darkness in [[Ravenheart Gloom]].
* *BONUS* Kill The {{sic|Unlike the previous objective, 'The' is capitalized here}} Greater Darkness in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 750 [[Lightbringer Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
After completing the repeatable quests [[To the Rescue!]], [[The Rifts Between Us]] and [[Deathbringer Company]] in Ravenheart Gloom, the Greater Darkness will spawn along with two of [[the Darkness]]es. They're easy to kill, but will spawn additional foes on death.

Killing or even surviving the additional foes is not required for this quest, but will progress the quest [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]] and spawn a reward chest.
